protocol: Research 0129 bounded breakthrough: six-element run contract written before launch

1_question_and_level.input_family: All length-20 binary sequences over {-1, +1} (2^20 candidates)
1_question_and_level.requested_conclusion: Within the declared budget, find and independently verify one low-energy sequence together with its energy and merit factor
1_question_and_level.level: Computation-level finite search; the 'reveal' working level is not interpreted and no physical energy is asserted
1_question_and_level.resolving_witness: The independently rechecked run report (best sequence, energy, correlations); exhaustion yields Unknown with its stopping reason

domains.result: E(s) = sum_k C_k(s)^2 for off-peak correlations C_k; merit factor = N^2 / (2E)
domains.scope: Exact integer arithmetic over fixed length N=20
domains.side_conditions: Binary entries in {-1, +1}; deterministic SplitMix64 seeds

domains.result: temporal / spatial / constructive deterministic search programs
domains.scope: Repository-local bounded experiment; not an external solver claim

2_imported_knowledge.conjectures: none imported; the search itself is the experiment
2_imported_knowledge.observations: LABS is a known hard finite combinatorial family; results here are trial evidence only

3_interface.translation: Candidate sequence -> (energy, merit_factor) via exact correlation arithmetic in Rust
3_interface.required_equality: report.verify() must independently recompute the same correlations and merit factor
3_interface.retained_distinctions: A score orders admissible proposals only; it is not physical energy, not global optimality, and not a native operation
3_interface.forgotten_distinctions: none; the checker refuses malformed reports

4_protected_obligations: No exhaustive-optimality claim at length 20 from this sampled search (exhaustive is a separate N<=25 command, not run here)
Resource exhaustion reports Unknown and retains the stopping reason; no automatic fuel reset
No new native word, vocabulary promotion, or language-formation step follows from a finite search result
The run report, checkpoint and contract bytes are retained as the audit trail

5_acceptance_and_verification.success: Search completes within budget AND report.verify() passes AND the independent verify command recomputes matching values
negative_controls: A one-field tampered copy of the report must be rejected by verify
5_acceptance_and_verification.unresolved_outcomes: Time or step budget exhaustion -> Unknown with reason; checker failure -> trial failed, artifacts retained

6_resources_and_exit.enforcement: Python supervisor enforces the wall-clock bound and captures exit codes; artifact sizes checked after exit
